entry.title: Hello, World
entry.content:
On Blogs and Online Publishing

It sucks. But sometimes it's the only way to put ideas out there.

And right now, I need to put a lot of ideas out there. So we'll give it a go.

Let's call this an opening salvo. Something to get started.

On the slab

Things. Floatsam. Works in Progress. Other curiosities.

  • Lancer RPG Homebrew: HOLO//MYTH, five frames + core bonuses based on the talents of Hololive English.
    • [ ] KIARA (Striker/Defender)
      • Current Status: Playtesting. Melee/CQB frame that wants both allies and enemies close and grouped up. Any tweaks likely to occur only on the statline, the rest of the frame seems stable enough. Been thinking of how to present these via web (aka this website), so I am looking into options.
    • [x] Planning
    • [x] Design
    • [x] Dev
    • [ ] Playtesting
    • [ ] Final Release
    • [ ] INA'NIS (Support/Controller?) - Current Status: Imploding. Either a tech-attacker/supporter or a drone user? I have designed at least 4 different versions of this frame, and none of them work the way I imagine them too. Player feedback has been rough. Might have to move work on this frame last, instead of second.
